device_policy: A100 80GB UUID-locked exclusive run; V100 and A100 40GB remain separate cohorts.
purpose: Explain positive and negative organization cases with matched hardware counters without replacing normal CUDA-event timing.

protocol.profile_timing: 1 warmup, 2 diagnostic repeats; profiler time is not merged into performance tables

cases.question: Does retaining a dependency-closed prefix reduce materialized traffic at a fixed arithmetic core?
When does launch fragmentation exceed the available inter-stage overlap?
Which resource changes when the arithmetic core changes under the same organization?
Does register residency reduce traffic and synchronization for a small butterfly tile?
Does the selected hierarchical mapping improve the word64 large-N resource balance?

claim_rules: A profile case is accepted only when its normal timing journal and profiler record have matching source, GPU UUID, mapping, and correctness identity.
A positive or negative profile explains one mechanism case; it does not establish a universal hardware cause.
Profiler timing and replay counters are diagnostic and never replace accepted CUDA-event medians.
Unavailable or failed cases remain explicit and do not enter the aggregate figure.
